name: nev
experimental: trial (#5): the player fails tucks and pokes, Nev is not made; make.py runs it only with --experimental
approved: owner, 2026-10-10 (#5): soma is for the rig, not the mesh; fit the prop pipeline's mesh to the rig; after the player, Nev in the space suit
why: Nev, the botanist, in her space suit on the prop route: her mesh made by Pixal3D from one close-up, as the animals' were, with SOMA-X's skeleton placed inside it so Kimodo's clips play unchanged
description: a Chinese woman in her thirties, a botanist of a Moon base, a small slim build, a short black pixie cut, thin round glasses

outfit_words.space: a white one-piece space suit: a round white helmet with a gold rim and its clear visor raised so her face shows, a light grey neck ring, a light grey chest box with a red flag with a yellow star and two dark knobs, green straps over the shoulders and down the front, a light grey waist box on a grey belt, a white backpack, a gold band and a red band round each upper arm, grey mittens, dark grey knee pads, red bands below the knees, chunky grey moon boots
outfit_words.work: a dark navy one-piece work suit: a stand collar, a front zip, light grey shoulder panels, thin red piping down the arms and the outer legs, a red flag patch with a yellow star on the left chest, a black belt with a steel buckle at the waist, cuffed sleeves ending at the wrists, trouser legs gathered over black lace-up boots

hair: short black pixie cut: short cropped sides and back close to the head, a short soft fringe swept to one side over the forehead, a little volume on top, ears uncovered
face: her face, short black hair and thin round glasses
